summary.prose: Building s1 replaces the second work-item id scheme with one strict identity module and moves every path, anchor and tracker call to it. The work goes in layers that keep the repository type-checking: the module and storage ids first, then the path key and the single Epic-anchor rule with explicit read and write intent, then the build validation and completion hook, then the tracker port, titles and guards, then the locate and importer moves, and finally the deletion of id.ts and the old migration tool with the docs.

Unit tests pin its output to the text storage.ts and nextAmendmentId build today and to the stored requirement ids.

stored requirement ids in the canonical and slug forms parse to date, hash8, story as a number and fr, and mint rejects an uppercase story
the new unit tests pass and the repository type-checks
